simple.meaning: דֶּשֶׁא (desheʼ) is a Hebrew action word meaning “a sprout ; by analogy, grass.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 15 times in Genesis, Deuteronomy, 2 Samuel, 2 Kings, Job, and 4 more, beginning at Genesis 1:11. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דֶּשֶׁא (H1877) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: דֶּשֶׁא (desheʼ) / H1877 is traced through Genesis 1:11, Genesis 1:12, Deuteronomy 32:2, 2 Samuel 23:4 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H1877. deshe דֶּ֫שֶׁא noun masculine Isa 15:6 grass (Late Hebrew id. , Assyrian dišu , herb , Lyon Sargontexte 69 ; Sabean דתֿא fresh shoots DHM ZMG 1875, 597 = springtime CIS iv. p. 11 ; Aramaic דִּתְאָה , (compare Lag BN 130 )) — ׳ד absolute Gen 1:11 + 13 t. — accusative of congnate meaning with verb תַּדְשֵׁא 1:11 ; compare 1:12 (in both, produced by earth); springing out of earth 2Sam 23:4 ; of a second crop of grass Prov 21:25 (opposed to חָצִיר ); caused to spring forth by God דֶ֑שֶׁא מֹצָא לְהַצְמִיחַ Job 38:27 ; refreshed by rain Deut 32:2 ; ד ׳נְאוֺת Psa 23:2 ; as food of wild ass Job 6:5 ; as failing (withered) Isa 15:6 ; lacking for animals Jer 14:5 ; דֶּשֶׁא וִירַק simile of weakness 2Kin 19:26 (|| שָׂדֶה עֵשֶׂב ) = Isa 37:27 ; of transitoriness (withering) Psa 37:2 ( ד ׳יֶרֶק ); of growth and prosperity, Isa 66:14 .
